About.heading: About
About.description: Back-end-focused Full-Stack Developer in Yogyakarta building reliable systems with Laravel, Node.js, and Golang.
About.paragraph: Back-end-focused Full-Stack Developer with a strong track record of architecting clean, scalable solutions to complex technical challenges. I use technologies such as PHP and JavaScript — including Laravel and Node.js — and am currently delving into Golang (Fiber). Skilled across the entire software development lifecycle, from optimizing existing features to designing new ones, and genuinely passionate about exploring new technology. Based in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, currently building Hospital Information Systems as a Full-Stack Developer at PT Medika Digital Nusantara. Bachelor of Informatic System, Universitas AKPRIND Yogyakarta (2021–2025), GPA 3.47.

bullets: Develop and maintain comprehensive Hospital Information Systems for multiple healthcare institutions using PHP, CSS, JavaScript, and OracleDB.
Architect and implement clinic web applications focused on ease of use and maintenance using Laravel and MySQL.
Create web interfaces based on the framework of the Analyzer System.
Optimize complex database schemas and queries to ensure accurate, real-time data usage.
Use Docker to ensure consistency across system environments.
Use pipelines and CI/CD to simplify deployment to the server.
Manage server environments with New Relic to monitor application health, diagnose issues through log analysis, and resolve production incidents with minimal downtime.
Implement data caching strategies using Redis, successfully reducing API response latency.
Integrate AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code into daily workflow, reducing boilerplate generation time by ~50% and accelerating feature delivery.
Developed 10+ web and mobile applications for clients in the industrial sector using Laravel, Golang, Flutter, React.js, Bootstrap, and Tailwind CSS.
Built a responsive admin dashboard with React.js and Tailwind CSS, displaying real-time analytics via charts and tables.
Built systems using Laravel libraries such as Spatie, Breeze, Octane, and Inertia to simplify and accelerate development.
Built mobile apps for employee management — attendance, task distribution, overtime — with lazy loading and real-time data using Flutter and Golang.
Designed and implemented a RESTful API used by 10+ daily active users, handling transactions at 99.9% uptime using a Laravel + Golang microservices architecture.
Implemented Figma-based responsive layouts with Tailwind CSS, and used AWS S3 for file storage.
Collaborated with a team of 2–3 people using Git/GitHub, applying Agile and Kanban methodologies.
Led development of SWAKARTA, a Waqf-based CMS platform with 20 customizable templates on Laravel MVC, enabling non-technical users to launch a professional website in under 30 minutes.
Built a modular template system using Laravel MVC architecture to support dynamic content management.
Collaborated with a cross-functional team of 4–6 members using Git/GitHub for version control, applying Agile and Kanban (Trello) methodologies.
